detail.longDescription: I've been going to the same barber for years. He has his own shop now, and everything is great, but booking at his old shop was a mess. I'd click "Book now" and get transported to a completely different site with a strange logo, which asked me to enter every shred of personal information I had. It felt like walking down a dark alley where every turn could be a virus, a credit card scam, or a guy in a trench coat selling counterfeit watches.
